Overall, Professor Rydell was a pretty good professor. He has a very monotone voice, but his hilariously dry sense of humor makes up for that. I find it hard to reconcile the negative comments on this page with my experience of him-- he is not difficult to understand at all (maybe his English has improved very quickly?) and he's a very good teacher!

Still pretty hard to understand, but the tests are easy if you study at all.  He grades really hard if you miss classes or tests, though--I was going to be graded down for this, but convinced him not to do so after a lot of discussion and proving that my alarm clock really had misfunctioned.
